title: Prawn and French Gratin
description: A rich and flavorful seafood dish with a crispy, cheesy topping.
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add mushrooms and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add prawns and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
In a separate saucepan, melt molten cheese over low heat.
Add cubed bread to the cheese and stir until bread is toasted.
Transfer the prawn mixture to a baking dish.
Top with the bread and cheese mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
